correctness.rationale: Robles-Pérez--Rosales Theorem4.6 proves Apéry w(r)=m beta(r)+r where beta counts Zeckendorf summands; hence qm+r is in S iff q>=beta(r). If a gap g=qm+r has both adjacent integers in S, comparison of beta(r-1),beta(r+1) forces q=beta(r)-1 and strict local maximum of beta (terminal residue separately). The left rise occurs iff digit index 2 appears; with it, right fall occurs iff digit index 4 also appears, by normalization of 2F2+F4=F5; at terminal r=m-1 parity is handled. Remaining digits are independent sets in positions 6..a-1; distinct residues follow from Zeckendorf uniqueness. Independent dynamic-programming membership and direct gap enumeration for all a=3..16 reproduced full sets, counts, and terminal boundary. Universal proof relies on symbolic digit argument and published Apéry theorem, not finite checking.
